basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old woman living in Toledo, Ohio, originally from Jaipur, India. I work as a graphic designer and have been married for 7 years. My husband and I have been trying to expand our family after experiencing a loss, so I'm navigating the world of IVF and FETs. I'm a night owl, usually online late evenings, and I enjoy engaging in discussions about fertility treatments and sharing experiences with others. Outside of Reddit, I'm an avid reader and love gardening.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in design, having studied graphic design at a local college. My knowledge in infertility treatments comes from personal experience and self-research, including reading medical journals and participating in online communities. I also lean on the advice of others who have been through similar experiences.
